problem_summary.summary: Increment by one a non-negative integer stored as its decimal digits from most significant to least significant.
problem_summary.input_output: Input: a nonempty digit array with no leading zero. Return the resulting digit array.

brute_force.explanation: Convert the digit sequence to a BigInteger, add one, and convert the result back to digits. This simple numeric formulation handles values longer than any primitive type, but allocates large integer and string representations.
brute_force.correctness_idea: The digit array represents the exact nonnegative integer. BigInteger addition computes that integer plus one without overflow, and converting its decimal representation back preserves the required encoding.
brute_force.time_complexity: O(n) digit work, excluding the implementation-dependent cost of BigInteger arithmetic; n is digits.length.
brute_force.space_complexity: O(n) auxiliary for the BigInteger and temporary decimal strings, in addition to the returned array.

optimized.explanation: Walk from the least significant digit leftward. Turn each trailing 9 into 0; at the first non-9 digit, increment it and return. If every digit was 9, create a new array one digit longer with leading 1.
optimized.correctness_idea: Decimal addition by one propagates a carry through exactly the trailing 9s. The first non-9 absorbs the carry and ends propagation; if none exists, the carry becomes a new leading digit.
optimized.time_complexity: O(n) worst case; the scan may pass through every digit and the all-9 case allocates a result array.
optimized.space_complexity: O(1) auxiliary when a digit absorbs the carry; O(n) for the new output array when all digits are 9.

steps.event: Inspect the least significant digit at index 2.
steps.condition: The current digit is 9, so adding one leaves a carry.
steps.action: Set digits[2] to 0 and continue left.

steps.condition: This digit is also 9, so the carry continues.
steps.action: Set digits[1] to 0 and continue left.

steps.condition: 2 is less than 9 and can absorb the carry.
steps.action: Increment it to 3 and return the same array.

edge_cases.handling: The optimized method increments it in place and returns the one-element array.
Each 9 becomes 0 until a digit can take the carry.
The method returns a new array containing a leading 1 followed by zeros.
The baseline uses BigInteger rather than a fixed-width primitive; the optimized method works directly on the array.
